text.tspan: Relations inside the old man's family tale, not a resolved history.
A · A list of missing people
Its later readers ask which names
A soldier - or a man whose brother was
Lends a pencil; later puts the pot on.
Arrive years later carrying the list.
Some hold photographs; some hold rope.
B > A: writes down the missing / C > B: lends pencil / D > A: returns with it / D > C: asks for identification / E > C: awaits an answer
The soldier and bereaved brother are alternative tellings. Whether the keeper later names anyone is unresolved.
